model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%). The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to $10^3$, marked at intervals of $10^0$, $10^1$, $10^2$, and $10^3$. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)", with a linear scale from 40 to 65, marked at intervals of 5. Six lines are plotted: Base (black, circle, solid), FT (blue, triangle down, solid), IKE (pink, triangle up, solid), MEND (brown, diamond, solid), MEMIT (purple, triangle up, solid), and ROME (green, square, solid). The Base line starts at approximately (3, 38) and ends at (1000, 44), steadily increasing. The FT line begins at around (3, 40) and concludes at (1000, 48), also showing a steady increase. The IKE line starts at (3, 44) and ends at (1000, 50), with a consistent upward trend. The MEND line begins at (3, 44) and ends at (1000, 57), increasing steadily. The MEMIT line starts at (30, 47) and ends at (1000, 55), showing a steady increase. The ROME line begins at (30, 52) and ends at (1000, 66), with a consistent upward trend.
